paths.label: Coding agents
paths.title: You already use a coding agent
paths.summary: Keep your agent and put the harness around it. By the end you can check a change against the tests you name, hand bounded work to the agents you already use, and leave a run unattended within limits.

paths.label: Science and HPC
paths.title: You write research code and run it on a cluster
paths.summary: For research code, where a wrong number matters. By the end you can follow a numerical fix to recorded verification, keep a speed-up only when a measurement proves it, and coordinate workers on other machines over SSH.

paths.label: Local models
paths.title: You run your own models
paths.summary: No account and no key. By the end you can choose models for conversation and for delegated work, read what each session cost, carry a long task through a handoff, and compare your models blind.
